verdict.rationale: Fellow, a SaaS meeting-notes platform, documents an official MCP server across its developer docs, help center and feature page. It works with any connector-capable AI tool, including Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, and lets users query meeting recaps, notes and action items without code. Admins can enable the server, choose which tools are exposed, revoke connections and see last-used timestamps, and access is scoped to each user's existing Fellow permissions; a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working connection, explicit tool inventory and setup/auth details in the evidence.
